vector_route: UNAVAILABLE -- no article PDF is served (fullTextPDF -> HTTP 404), so chains.vector_bonds has no bond coordinates to read. Both counts below are raster-side but methodologically independent.

C8_acyl.what: the N-acyl chain, lower left of the C8 panel
C8_acyl.DISAGREE: turns=8 crossings=7 apex_vertices=8. curation/lib/chains.py's contract is that independent methods must AGREE; a disagreement is NOT averaged and NOT resolved by preferring a route. At ~9 px per bond on a flattened JPEG a +/-1 ambiguity is real, and it is recorded as one.

acyl_difference_identity._what: C16 acyl minus C8 acyl, by each method independently. Hexadecanoyl minus octanoyl = exactly 8 carbons.

sphingoid_base_consistency._what: Both panels draw the SAME sphingoid base; only the N-acyl chain is meant to differ. This is a chemical constraint the reads must satisfy, not an assumption imported into them.
sphingoid_base_consistency.VERDICT: The sphingoid base length is NOT pinned to +/-1 by this raster: apex-vertex counting makes the two panels agree and mid-line crossing counting does not. The base is therefore taken from the reagent's CHEMICAL NAME, and every emitted row carrying this helper lipid is flagged structure_assumed = 1 with the reason on the row.

EMISSION_RELEVANT_RESULT._what: What the emitted rows actually depend on.
EMISSION_RELEVANT_RESULT.C8_acyl_unresolved: crossings=7 bonds (8 C, matching the token) against turns=8 and apex=8. Recorded, NOT resolved. It changes nothing emitted: no row in this curation carries C8GaCer.
EMISSION_RELEVANT_RESULT.sphingoid_base_unresolved: crossings makes both panels 14 bonds; apex and turns make the C16 panel 13. A +/-1 ambiguity at ~9 px per bond on a flattened JPEG. The base is therefore taken from the reagent's chemical name and every row carrying it is flagged structure_assumed.
